title: RelicTech: Important Systems
summary: Read the RelicTech signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Phase anchors, matter stitchers, guardian lenses, echo mirrors, null batteries, and analyzer behavior all reflect the same rule: power has a state.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch charge, cooldown, identity, instability, anchors, analyzer output, and whether a relic solves the current problem or creates a more expensive one.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A RelicTech system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
